independence.prerequisite_note: The parent was responsible for validating the two actual working zero-addition passes before dispatch. This reviewer did not inspect prior reports and does not certify that operational prerequisite from forbidden evidence.

asked_fact_mapping_findings.literal_question: Which matching lands Explore, how many Explorers are added if there are multiple sources, do Explorers themselves provide a source, and what happens if no Invader Card can be drawn?
asked_fact_mapping_findings.exact_old_text: Needing to draw from an empty Invader deck loses; drawing its last existing card alone does not.

correction.required_fact: Needing to draw from an empty Invader deck loses.
correction.move_to_key_context_not_required: Drawing its last existing card alone does not lose.

asked_fact_mapping_findings.reason: The question asks the consequence when no card can be drawn. Whether drawing the final available card itself loses is a separate source-correct background state. An answer that says inability to draw loses, while answering the other three Explore clauses correctly, is complete without separately narrating this last-card guard. Do not require the guard when the answer already respects it.
asked_fact_mapping_findings.minimal_complete_answer_for_affected_cla: If an Invader Card must be drawn and none can be drawn, the players lose.

primary_sources.label: CORE p12 Time Runs Out
primary_sources.exact_passage:
If you need to draw an Invader Card (to Explore), but the Invader Deck is  
 
 empty, you lose.

asked_fact_mapping_findings.coverage_effect: No new question requested: this is background to the existing empty-deck loss condition, not a distinct missing base procedure.

asked_fact_mapping_findings.literal_question: Does Infinite Vitality’s threshold save Dahan from Remove or Replace? Does its Blight protection prohibit choosing the land as a cascade destination?
asked_fact_mapping_findings.exact_old_text: Infinite Vitality's threshold protects from Damage/Destroy but does not prevent Remove/Replace.

correction.required_fact: Infinite Vitality's threshold does not prevent Remove/Replace of Dahan.
correction.move_to_key_context_not_required: Infinite Vitality's threshold protects Dahan from Damage/Destroy.

asked_fact_mapping_findings.reason: The literal threshold question is confined to Remove or Replace. The positive Damage/Destroy protection is true but is not an additional requested assertion here. A complete negative answer on both Remove and Replace must not lose credit for omitting the positive protection statement. The cascade-choice clause remains required; its explanatory wording may be accepted through an equivalent unambiguous statement that the choice remains legal.
asked_fact_mapping_findings.minimal_complete_answer: No: its threshold does not save Dahan from Remove or Replace. No: its Blight protection does not prohibit choosing that land for a cascade.

primary_sources.label: FAQ .bu6ocxx; positive protection and distinct Remove/Replace exclusion
primary_sources.exact_passage:
What does the threshold effect of Infinite Vitality protect against?
(.bu6ocxx)
Anything that would Damage or Destroy Dahan in that land, whether Powers, invader Ravages, Events, etc.
It does not protect against effects that "remove" or "replace" the Dahan.

asked_fact_mapping_findings.coverage_effect: Damage/Destroy protection is actually asked elsewhere (Q117 and Q118); no new question is needed.

common.interpretation: Fixed keys may retain correct unasked background. Only actual asks are grading and coverage requirements. Two small mixed required-fact strings need the unasked portions moved to context. All retained conditional regression clauses remain graded even when current-base novelty credit is zero.

coverage_only.remaining_gap_definition: Distinct eligible original-core procedural permission, timing, eligibility, exception or source-defined branch absent from actual asks. This count does not include two rubric over-demands requiring map correction.

complete_corpus_challenge.method: Read all permitted primary prose and all required visual faces first; compare every actual ask/key and every mapped required fact; challenge source-defined procedures and exceptions against literal asks; independently verify scope and membership; reject ordinary variants, numerical payloads and unavailable effect producers. Neither compact-map breadth nor previous zero-addition claims substitutes for an actual ask.

source_families.corpus_unit: CORE p8 / turn order, individual sequencing and decision authority
source_families.assessment: Individual Grow/income/play order, new track income, global phase barrier, freely chosen Power sequence and owner/starting-board/any-player authority exceptions are asked separately. source_families.corpus_unit: CORE pp9,12 / Fear and outcome timing
source_families.assessment: Markers and excess Fear, current Terror, hidden earned stack, newly earned cards, full each-player instruction units, Scapegoats per-land actions and complete action-tree/sacrifice victory boundaries are asked. source_families.corpus_unit: CORE pp13–14 / Presence, resources and tracks
source_families.assessment: Ownership/Sacred Sites, highest rather than additive track benefits, either-track leftmost removal, immediate bonuses, Reclaim timing, Any choice, reposition destination/origin and destroyed-disk restrictions are actually asked. New arrangements or counts are applications, not new rule branches.

source_families.corpus_unit: CORE pp16–17 / targeting and instruction execution
source_families.assessment: Use-time targets, one land/use, maximum Range, numeric versus categorical restrictions, mandatory possible parts, complete foregoing/no refund, consistent fewer Elements, Instead and explicit First/Before timing are each actually tested. source_families.corpus_unit: CORE p18 / card gain, Forget and permanent versus temporary effects
source_families.assessment: Draw/keep/discard/reshuffle, separate Major Forget obligation, zones including new Major/in-play, immediate Elements/unused-use loss and persistent resolved effects are asked; transfers and Entwined same-draw/gift-hand exceptions are separately asked. No arbitrary card-name enumeration is required.

Direct Dahan Damage producer is kept unverified rather than imported.

source_families.corpus_unit: CORE p19 / Repeat and explicit-grant exceptions

Conditional internal-Range and speed-reversal clauses remain graded without base credit.
